runs.name: Final model/generator CPU checks with actual record bundles
Final CPU/CUDA generator/model/roundtrips plus both-device stiffness/minimization
Final CPU provenance and explicit 61-angle checks
Final attachment bond-order validation and generator CPU suite

notes: Counts overlap; do not sum as unique tests. Pure RDKit/model checks use CPU in either environment; native energies/gradients and diagnostics use CPU/CUDA.
The private prototype is not enabled by default. It generates two-block harmonic length/angle terms only; local atom typing/charges/torsions, three-block angles and context selection remain open.
Independent RDKit energy/force curvature checks cover water bond/bent angle and HCN linear angle. The model omits MMFF anharmonic and stretch-bend terms.
Native generated-record coverage includes 15 source links and 61 adjacent angles. Stiffness diagnostic covers 14 anchored links and 3 peptide controls per device.
Both-device full-score biotin Cartesian minimizations improve energy and restore the bond within 0.1 angstrom of its target, with every masked-out atom unchanged.
Final provenance records the compiled protonation rule hash and selection policy; this metadata-only addition was verified in the final CPU run.
No independent scientific parameter fit or full-force-field validation is claimed.
